runtimePolicy: Connections are metadata-only unless a downstream project explicitly adopts the handoff contract.
evidencePolicy: First-party repository activity cannot independently validate market demand.

projects.name: NeedRadar
projects.evidenceBoundary: A published brief is a governed repeated signal, not customer adoption or product-market fit.

projects.name: AI Skill Product Discovery
projects.evidenceBoundary: Selection, rejection, and deferral remain explicit research decisions; a score does not prove demand.

projects.name: BillFit
projects.evidenceBoundary: Engineering validation and a public release do not establish adoption, savings, or market demand.

projects.name: From Feed to Agent
projects.evidenceBoundary: The study is one research artifact; its rows or respondents are never inflated into independent NeedRadar observations.

projects.name: JobFlow
projects.evidenceBoundary: Private profiles, resumes, application state, secure references, and external-action records never enter NeedRadar.
